findings.acceptanceDisposition: Open; no public stack outcome established and no worker fix round consumed.
findings.cause: readerFor returns only issuer, subject, emailVerified and cloned contentEvidence. It drops currentAssertion, accountExpiresAt and Account consent/scope/client identity. The corrected retained reader receives a static principal, so currentReader cannot call the real token/scope verifier or enforce expiry. The enclosing session does not compensate: fenceAuthority checks only the Access principal/recovery state, and activePrincipalId queries issuer/subject without Account introspection. findings.cloneBoundary: projection.basis is typed to receive RetainedCreditAssociationReadBasis and structuredClone(credit) clones its principal. Merely restoring a live callback in readerFor would expose a DataCloneError at this second boundary. Pass the full live principal into the retained reader while passing only RetainedCreditAssociationReadPosition to serializable projection/cursor consumers.
